title: GDD T-114 — Arsenal cangrejo + eventos + FINAL_WAGER en tablero (§5.4, §5.5) [gate Hito 4]
description: Completes the board: weapons, round modifiers, and the wager wired into BOARD/session flow. Arsenal (§5.4): max 1 weapon held (pickup replaces); used during BOARD_RESOLVE by aiming with stick + tap confirm. Guante de boxeo: usable ONLY against the 1st-place player; target loses 50% of coins which fall to the board floor and are shared among players within 2 squares. Imán: steals 1 object or 6 coins, range <= 4 squares. Colmena: area — everyone on and adjacent to the target square loses 3 coins toward the thrower, thrower immune. Structural anti-leader targeting is code; the decision to fire is the group's (P5). Eventos (§5.5): seeded draw among DobleVelocidad (next microgame 1.5x), MuerteSubita, ModoPinata, LluviaDeMonedas (+2 all), Apagon (score HUD hidden until end) — wired as RoundModifier through BoardResolution into the session. FINAL_WAGER integrates the TASK-037 wager into the FSM's FINAL_WAGER state with the 5 s stick choice. Hito 4 gate (§17): economic invariants green over 1000 bot-simulated full sessions; complete session inside the §2.2 time budget. Read GDD §5.4/§5.5, §6.2, §2.2 before coding.
acceptance_criteria: All three weapons implement their exact restriction rules (guante only-vs-leader, iman range 4, colmena thrower-immune) with every coin flow expressed as visible origin->destination CoinDeltas
Inventory: holding max 1, pickup replaces, weapon consumed on use; targeting flow (stick aim + tap) resolves within BOARD_RESOLVE's 10 s budget
The 5 eventos exist as seeded RoundModifiers reaching the next microgame/session state (DobleVelocidad multiplies speed-scaling params; Apagon hides scores until GAME_OVER)
FINAL_WAGER state consumes the TASK-037 wager implementation with compulsory 25/50/75 choice and timeout default
Hito 4 gate: 1000 full bot-driven sessions (TASK-038 bots) show zero economic-invariant violations and every session inside the 2.2 time budget
Tests-first; fast suite green after, no regression

comments.body: CLOSED via rev-t042 FULL review — VERDICT CLOSE, no HIGH (2 MEDIUM + 6 LOW follow-ups). *** HITO 4 COMPLETE. *** Review depth = FULL (rubric: modifies the session FSM + core board logic + a milestone gate = three mandatory-FULL triggers). Suites re-run firsthand: fast 654->668 (+14), slow 8->9 (+1), 0 regressions. CENTRAL CHARGE (gate vacuity) CLEARED: the payout-bypass is TRUE+verified (PayoutRules.cs:46,60 do coins[seat]+= with no CoinDelta, pre-existing TASK-051/052) but the gate is NOT substantially vacuous — negative-balance (replay-derived, an unclamped drain FAILS) + FINAL_WAGER-conservation (sum equality) assertions are genuinely failable; weapon/evento conservation faithful-by-construction; the sweep genuinely grants+fires weapons + draws eventos (BoardBotDriver 80% fire hits both fire and restriction-rejection paths). AC1 weapons: guante leader-gated (tie->lowest seat [ASSUMED]) target->Bank 50% then Bank->recipients<=2sq; iman <=4sq steal 6-clamped-or-object; colmena <=1sq -3->thrower, thrower-immune (tested); ineligible tap = no-op, weapon not consumed. AC2 inventory max1/replace/consume + two sequential resolve sub-windows (4s deposit + 4s weapon = 8s < 10s §2.2). AC3 eventos: DobleVelocidad x1.5 confirmed reaching EsquivaMicrogame effective params, Apagon sticky-hide-until-GameOver, LluviaDeMonedas +2 (reconciliation break caught by 2 pre-existing tests + FIXED via SetBalances re-sync, verified). AC4 FINAL_WAGER fully PRE-EXISTING (audited ~10 wager tests, no change). AC5 Hito4 gate: 1000 full sessions 8.8s, max 145.6s vs 289s ceiling, zero econ + zero time violations. NO new SessionPhase/edge (SessionPhase.cs untouched). NO existing-test laundering (both modified test files purely additive, zero deletions). Determinism clean (all via SeededRandom RngStream.Board/.Bots). tdd ordering genuine (ace998c compile-RED CS1061). FOLLOW-UPS: TASK-071 (M1 emit payout CoinDeltas + drive real payouts through the gate; M2 add per-seed Coins==BoardSnapshot.Balances assertion across 1000 seeds), TASK-072 (L5 MuerteSubita/ModoPinata behavioral effects, blocked on a future lives/damage mechanic). HUMAN [ASSUMED] RATIFICATION (design nods, non-blocking): L2 Guante floor-share includes the TARGET as a recipient (leader recovers ~25%, blunts the anti-leader weapon); L6 LluviaDeMonedas '+2 a todos' includes IDLE seats; plus the [ASSUMED] aggregate time ceiling formula. Linked ace998c/1bfc2f8, depth FULL.
